about.title: A local translator, not a faceless agency
about.body: I live in Herceg Novi and help Russian speakers and foreigners deal with documents and Montenegrin authorities every day. I know how things really work here — not from a manual — and I explain it in plain language.

points.p1: You deal with me directly — no intermediaries, no subcontractors
points.p2: I know residence, notary and bank procedures from the inside
points.p3: Herceg Novi, Kotor, Tivat, Budva — the whole Bay of Kotor

about.langsLabel: Russian native · Serbian and English fluent

reviews.title: When it is better not to go alone
reviews.subtitle: In Montenegro, the hard part is often not just the words. It is knowing what to ask, what to clarify and what the office actually needs.

r1.title: Documents and notary
r1.text: A contract, certificate, diploma or power of attorney often needs more than literal translation. It needs to make sense for the bank, MUP or notary reading it.
r1.result: A clear translation, a list of missing papers and, when needed, certification arranged through a sworn translator.

r2.title: Appointments with offices
r2.text: At the police, municipality, bank or hospital, you need to understand the question quickly, answer calmly and avoid getting lost in procedure.
r2.result: I stay with you at the appointment, translate the conversation and explain the next step.

r3.title: Relocation and everyday tasks
r3.text: Residence permits, rent, buying property, opening a company or a bank account are made of many small steps where language mistakes cost time.
r3.result: A practical route, support at key steps and clear communication with local specialists.

faq.title: The essentials, briefly
faq.registerLink: Ministry of Justice register of court interpreters

q1.q: Are you a sworn court translator (sudski tumač)?
q1.a: No. I do interpreting and translation, and I arrange certified translations for court and notary through a sworn translator — so you don't have to find one yourself.

q2.q: Which languages do you work with?
q2.a: Russian, English and Serbian (Montenegrin) in any combination.

q3.a: Accompaniment — €10–15/hour, document translation — per page, relocation support — individual. I'll give an exact price after a short description of your task.

q4.a: Usually within a day. For urgent matters, message me on Telegram and I'll reply sooner.

q5.q: Do you travel outside Herceg Novi?
q5.a: Yes — I work across the whole Bay of Kotor: Tivat, Kotor, Budva and around.

sections.title: Who processes your data
sections.body: This site is run by Nikolai, a translator in Herceg Novi (Montenegro). For any questions about your data, write to nikolaistukov38@gmail.com.

sections.title: What data is collected
sections.body: The data you voluntarily submit through the form: your name, contact (Telegram or phone) and a description of your task. Anonymous visit statistics are also collected — without advertising cookies.

sections.title: Why
sections.body: To reply to your request, discuss your task and provide the translation service. The legal basis is your request and the consent given when submitting the form.

sections.title: Who receives the data
sections.body: Form messages are delivered via the Web3Forms service; the site is hosted on Vercel. Data is not sold or shared with third parties for marketing.

sections.title: How long it is kept
sections.body: As long as needed for correspondence about your request. Data is deleted at your request.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data — just write to the email above.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: The site uses no advertising or tracking cookies. Visit analytics are anonymous.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: This policy may be updated. The current date is shown at the top of the page.
